test_wrap_named_array: test wrapping a JAX array into a NamedArray with positional and named shapes
test_named_array_tag_untag: test tagging and untagging axes on a NamedArray to manage named dimensions
test_named_array_untag_prefix: test untagging and retagging axis prefixes on a NamedArray with positional axes
test_nmap_mapped_function: test mapping a function over named axes using nmap with mixed array and non-array arguments
test_indexed_update_at: test indexed updates on NamedArray using at[].set and at[].add with positional and dict styles
test_binop_broadcast: test binary operations between NamedArrays with broadcasting over shared and unique named axes
test_convenience_constructors: test convenience constructors zeros, ones, full, arange for creating NamedArrays with named shapes
test_array_concatenate_stack: test concatenating, stacking, and unstacking NamedArrays along named axes
test_order_like_structure: test reordering NamedArray axes to match a target structure using order_like
test_broadcast_to_shape: test broadcasting NamedArrays to a specified positional shape and named shape
test_scan_over_named_axis: test scanning a function over a named axis while preserving carry and output structures
test_indexing_by_dict: test indexing NamedArrays using dict-style selectors with slices and scalar indices
test_indexing_batched: test batched indexing of NamedArrays using another tagged NamedArray as indices
test_tree_order_like: test reordering all NamedArrays within a nested Python structure to match a target tree
test_jax_compilation_slice_index: test JAX JIT compilation with captured slice indices in NamedArray indexing
